notes.GAN: Gandhi's ahimsa extends nonviolence to all living beings: 2.
notes.TW: Zhuangzi's equality of things (qiwu) denies that creatures exist for human use: 2.
notes.CST: Laudato Si' 33 and 69: every creature has its own value and purpose in God's eyes, independent of its usefulness: 2.
notes.OB: Rand: rights belong only to rational beings; animals have none and nature has no intrinsic value (Virtue of Selfishness): -3.
notes.SC: Chrysippus and Cicero: animals exist for the sake of humans, with whom they share no justice: -2.
notes.MA: Mao's Four Pests campaign and 'man must conquer nature' made wildlife subject to human utility: -2.
notes.ML: Engels and Soviet practice (Michurin: 'we cannot wait for favours from nature') treat nature as material to transform: -1.
notes.CR: Genesis 1:28 dominion theology is split between stewardship (Evangelical Environmental Network) and use: -1, split.
